note: The definitions 0.2.8 starts with, each version 1 of a definition lineage in log.sqlite, whose id is the digest of its family and this first name (from the 0.2.8 reference schemas' definitions). A family's spec is contract content the Host checks for form.

families.event_type: what may be written to the log, and the shape of its attributes
families.artifact_type: what an artifact is, where its body lives and which measures every one of its kind records
families.metric: how a measure is computed; a recorded value names the version it was made under
families.method: a computation a recipe names; its version moves only when its values move
families.feature_set: the factors of one wide derived table
families.source: an outside data source: its world table, its key and its fields
families.lag_rule: how long after its valid date a source's row became known, for rows with no known time of their own
families.tag: a tag key and the values it admits
families.node: a module: what it provides, uses, emits and owns
families.provider: an outside data provider; world rows name it by its lineage's id
families.sector_scheme: a sector classification; world.sector rows name it by its lineage's id
families.universe: a set of listings over time; world.universe_member rows name it by its lineage's id
families.world_table: a world table of the catalog; world.superseded names it by its lineage's id

event_types.name: registry.seeded
event_types.description: The seed definitions were registered.

event_types.name: definition.registered
event_types.subject: definition
event_types.description: A definition version was added; its text is the definition's canonical JSON.

event_types.name: definition.status_changed
event_types.subject: definition
event_types.description: A version became standard, deprecated or superseded.

event_types.name: definition.renamed
event_types.subject: definition
event_types.description: A definition lineage took a new name; its id, versions and every name it held stay.

event_types.name: workspace.created
event_types.subject: workspace
event_types.description: A workspace tag was made.

event_types.name: workspace.opened
event_types.subject: workspace
event_types.description: A workspace was opened.

event_types.name: workspace.status_changed
event_types.subject: workspace
event_types.description: A workspace was archived, lost or deleted.

event_types.name: setting.changed
event_types.subject: setting
event_types.description: The person changed a setting.

event_types.name: goal.set
event_types.subject: goal
event_types.description: A goal was set.

event_types.name: goal.closed
event_types.subject: goal
event_types.description: A goal was met or dropped.

event_types.name: task.requested
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: A Task was admitted; its text is the frozen request it was admitted to do, and its record follows (`task.saved`).

event_types.name: task.requested
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: A Task was admitted under its one parent: `parent_task_id`, else `goal_id`, else neither (its workspace); its text is the frozen request, and its record follows (`task.saved`).

event_types.name: task
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: One execution of a task; it also records `started`.

event_types.name: step.completed
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: A slow step, or one with an outside effect, finished; a restart skips it.

event_types.name: wait.started
event_types.subject: wait
event_types.description: A task began to wait for an event or a time.

event_types.name: wait.resolved
event_types.subject: wait
event_types.description: The wait ended.

event_types.name: task.saved
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: A Task's record, its text, was sealed at its next version.

event_types.name: work_item.saved
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: A Task's work item, its text, was sealed at its next version; its first save names its place.

event_types.name: task.noted
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: Task Control noted what happened to a Task, its details the text: a transition, a wake, a recovery link, an admission subject.

event_types.name: execution.started
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: An execution of a Task, its text, began on a bound worker.

event_types.name: stage.verified
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: A Task's stage was verified by its receipt, the text.

event_types.name: command.accepted
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: A command on a Task, its text, was accepted against the version it confirmed.

event_types.name: command.resolved
event_types.subject: task
event_types.description: An accepted command was resolved.

event_types.name: admission
event_types.subject: admission
event_types.description: The step that fetched, checked and wrote outside data.

event_types.name: admission.committed
event_types.subject: admission
event_types.description: Outside data entered the world; the catalog commit carried this event.

event_types.name: selection.made
event_types.subject: selection
event_types.description: What a piece of research may see was fixed.

event_types.name: recipe.defined
event_types.subject: recipe
event_types.description: An action's definition was first used.

event_types.name: hypothesis.stated
event_types.subject: hypothesis
event_types.description: A hypothesis was stated; its text is the statement.

event_types.name: hypothesis.standing_changed
event_types.subject: hypothesis
event_types.description: Evidence moved a hypothesis's standing; trial_id names the trial that moved it.

event_types.name: trial.registered
event_types.subject: trial
event_types.description: A trial was registered before it ran, with its state summary.

event_types.name: trial
event_types.subject: trial
event_types.description: The trial's run; it also records `started`.

event_types.name: artifact.produced
event_types.subject: artifact
event_types.description: An artifact was made; these attributes are its profile.

event_types.name: result.recorded
event_types.subject: artifact
event_types.description: Measures of an artifact: a list of metric, version, dims and value.

event_types.name: artifact.collected
event_types.subject: artifact
event_types.description: An artifact's body was removed; its profile and measures stay.

event_types.name: conclusion.drawn
event_types.description: A conclusion about its subject (a trial, a hypothesis, a goal).

event_types.name: lesson.recorded
event_types.description: A lesson for later work, about its subject.

event_types.name: proposal.made
event_types.description: An agent proposed something for the person to decide.

event_types.name: review.completed
event_types.description: A review of its subject: an agent's note on a trial, task or goal, whose text holds its hypothesis, method, conclusion and lessons and whose attributes its verdict and its run's aggregates. It closes what it reviews.

event_types.name: experience.recorded
event_types.subject: experience
event_types.description: A review's note rendered into one experience body (blobs/, by its BLAKE3): version 1 makes the experience and points its layer at it, replacing the one before; a later version renders the same note anew. task_id names the task that made it.

event_types.name: decision.made
event_types.subject: decision
event_types.description: A decision, the alternatives weighed and, as text, the reasons.

event_types.name: prediction.registered
event_types.subject: prediction
event_types.description: A prediction was registered before its outcome.

event_types.name: outcome.observed
event_types.description: What happened at the horizon, for its subject.

event_types.name: prediction.scored
event_types.subject: prediction
event_types.description: A prediction was scored against its outcome.

event_types.name: feedback.given
event_types.description: The person adopted its subject or did not, read from what they did.

event_types.name: tag.added
event_types.description: A research-memory key was put on its subject.

event_types.name: tag.removed
event_types.description: A wrong key was taken off its subject.

event_types.name: trial.kept
event_types.subject: trial
event_types.description: The person keeps a trial's artifacts.

event_types.name: book.activated
event_types.subject: book
event_types.description: A strategy book went active, on paper or live.

event_types.name: book.rebalanced
event_types.subject: book
event_types.description: An active book's target holdings moved to a new artifact.

event_types.name: book.retired
event_types.subject: book
event_types.description: A book was retired.

event_types.name: artifact.held
event_types.subject: artifact
event_types.description: A workspace keeps an artifact's body: its live_ref until the workspace lets it go.

event_types.name: artifact.pinned
event_types.subject: artifact
event_types.description: The person pins an artifact's body: the pin `pin_id` holds it until it is unpinned.

event_types.name: artifact.unpinned
event_types.subject: artifact
event_types.description: The person lets the pin `pin_id` go; the body is collected once nothing holds it.

event_types.name: publication.released
event_types.subject: artifact
event_types.description: An artifact was published outside the machine.

event_types.name: ledger.posted
event_types.subject: book
event_types.description: A fill, a fee or a cash movement: balanced ledger lines.

event_types.name: record.forgotten
event_types.description: The person had a record's text removed; this tombstone stays.

event_types.name: chain.checkpointed
event_types.description: The chain head was kept: monthly, in a backup or in an export.

event_types.name: backup.made
event_types.description: A backup finished; it holds the chain head of its moment.

event_types.name: agent.turn
event_types.description: One turn of an agent.

event_types.name: model.call
event_types.description: A model call: its metadata under OpenTelemetry's GenAI names, never its transcript.

event_types.name: tool.call
event_types.description: An agent's call into the product.

metrics.name: ann_vol
metrics.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns.

metrics.name: sharpe
metrics.description: Annualized mean excess daily return over its standard deviation.

metrics.name: max_drawdown
metrics.description: The largest peak-to-trough fall of the net value, as a positive fraction.

metrics.name: turnover
metrics.description: Annualized one-way turnover of the holdings.

metrics.name: cost_bps
metrics.description: Trading cost charged, in basis points a year.

metrics.name: ic_mean
metrics.description: Mean rank correlation of the score with the forward return; dims carry the horizon.

metrics.name: ic_ir
metrics.description: Mean of the information coefficient over its standard deviation.

metrics.name: hit_rate
metrics.description: Share of periods with a positive return.

metrics.name: brier
metrics.description: Squared error of a stated probability against the outcome.

metrics.name: coverage
metrics.description: Share of the universe the artifact has a value for.

artifact_types.name: backtest
artifact_types.description: A simulated book's net value over a period.

artifact_types.name: alpha_score
artifact_types.description: A score per listing and date.

artifact_types.name: array
artifact_types.description: An array with no coordinates (a numerical lane's columns), its body kept once per machine.

artifact_types.name: report
artifact_types.description: A written report for the person.

artifact_types.name: evidence_packet
artifact_types.description: The evidence passages selected for one analysis.

artifact_types.name: scratch
artifact_types.description: An intermediate result that is never stored; only its profile and measures are.

artifact_types.name: outcome
artifact_types.description: What happened after: a trial's or a book's realized measures over a horizon, with dims naming it.

tags.name: instrument
tags.description: A listing the subject is about.

tags.name: theme
tags.description: A research theme, such as momentum or reversal.

tags.name: regime
tags.description: The market condition the subject was done under.

tags.name: quality
tags.description: How far the subject can be trusted.
